title: Is there a free trial?
summary: Yes — the AWS Marketplace subscription includes a 30-day free trial of the licence, cancellable at any time; AWS infrastructure costs are billed separately.
bodyMd:
Yes. Subscribing to Personalisation Hub in AWS Marketplace starts a 30-day free trial of the platform licence, which you can cancel at any time. The trial runs in your own AWS account, so you test the full platform with your own stores and displays.

The licence fee covers the software only. The AWS infrastructure the stack provisions — EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, ElastiCache, MSK, OpenSearch and related services — is billed by AWS separately and is not free during the trial. Choose a smaller environment size and a scheduled scale-down for a trial environment to keep those costs low, and cancel the subscription in AWS Marketplace if you decide not to continue.

The licence is tied to the AWS account that provisions the stack; there are no licence keys to enter. Current pricing and billing dimensions are on the AWS Marketplace listing.

To start, follow Step 1 — Deploy the platform through AWS Marketplace. For licensing, environment sizes and cost control, see AWS deployment: lifecycle management.
